packageRules.description: The service gets its fabric8 jars from the Quarkus BOM, so a separate fabric8 bump mixes versions at runtime (NoClassDefFoundError). Move fabric8 together with a Quarkus update, and keep kubernetes-client.version equal to the version the Quarkus BOM manages.
Sample project shipped for the demo, not a dependency of this repo.
Terraform providers use unbounded >= constraints; only surface a PR when the floor genuinely moves.
